nodes.description: ERC20 spore token used by the factory, set during initialize.
Reference to the MushroomNFT contract that is minted/grown by the factory.
Configured cost per mushroom, assigned in initialize.
Species id this factory is allowed to mint, used for cap checks and minting.
Monotonic salt counter mixed with block.timestamp to derive lifespans.
Mapping tokenId => MushroomData metadata (species, strength, lifespan).
Mapping speciesId => MushroomType metadata including minted counter and cap.
Mapping speciesId => existence flag for species metadata.
Mapping speciesId => metadata URI returned by tokenURI.
Owner address used by onlyOwner checks and transferOwnership.
Initializer wiring sporeToken, mushroomNft, cost, species and transferring ownership to the pool.
Initializer that sets up Ownable, AccessControl, ERC721 and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender.
Derives a pseudo-random lifespan from block.timestamp and spawnCount salt.
View returning remaining mintable amount for the factory species via the NFT contract.
Owner-restricted loop that computes nextId, lifespan and mints mushrooms via the NFT.
onlyMinter gated mint entrypoint delegating to _mintWithMetadata.
Burns a token after checking caller is approved/owner and clears mushroom data.
LIFESPAN_MODIFIER_ROLE gated setter that mutates stored mushroom lifespan.
onlyOwner setter for species metadata URI.
Internal mint validating species existence, cap and incrementing minted counter before _safeMint.
Internal helper decrementing the species minted counter on burn.
onlyOwner setter that registers/updates a species type.
onlyOwner function that reassigns the _owner state variable.
Caller-controlled address used for role, owner and approval checks.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used as randomness seed for lifespans.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp.add(spawnCount))) % range pseudo-randomness.
species.minted.add(1) arithmetic counter update during minting.
species.minted.sub(1) arithmetic counter update during burn.
maxLifespan.sub(minLifespan) range computation for lifespan randomness.
External call mushroomNft.mint(...) made before/within the growMushrooms loop.
Low-level to.call(onERC721Received selector) invoked during _safeMint.
recipient address argument for growMushrooms/mint/_mintWithMetadata.
Number of mushrooms to grow in growMushrooms loop.
Species identifier argument used for existence/cap lookups and minting.
Lifespan value assigned to the minted mushroom or set via setMushroomLifespan.
tokenId index argument of setMushroomLifespan.
Minimum lifespan bound passed to _generateMushroomLifespan.
Maximum lifespan bound passed to _generateMushroomLifespan.
Locally computed next token id = totalSupply + 1 inside growMushrooms.
Local lifespan range used as modulus for randomness.

edges.reason: initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender, giving it full role administration.
msg.sender is assigned as _owner during __Ownable_init_unchained.
mint is gated by onlyMinter, which checks msg.sender holds MINTER_ROLE.
setMushroomLifespan is gated by onlyLifespanModifier, checking msg.sender role.
burn requires msg.sender be approved or owner via _isApprovedOrOwner.
setSpeciesUri is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender.
setMushroomType is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender.
block.timestamp is the entropy source for _generateMushroomLifespan, enabling miner manipulation.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 modulo randomness derivation.
spawnCount salt is packed with the timestamp seed before hashing.
The timestamp-derived unsafe randomness executes inside _generateMushroomLifespan.
growMushrooms invokes _generateMushroomLifespan for each new mushroom.
growMushrooms checks the remaining mintable cap via getRemainingMintableForMySpecies.
minLifespan is an operand of maxLifespan.sub(minLifespan).
maxLifespan is the receiver of the sub() range computation.
The range subtraction result is used inside _generateMushroomLifespan as modulus.
The local range variable is the divisor of the modulo randomness expression.
fromMin offset is added back to minLifespan to produce the final lifespan.
Locally fetched species min/max lifespan bounds are passed to the lifespan generator.
growMushrooms calls mushroomNft.mint in a loop, an external call into the NFT contract.
recipient argument is forwarded to the external mushroomNft.mint call.
numMushrooms controls the iteration count of the growMushrooms loop.
The external mint call targets the mushroomNft state variable.
Locally computed nextId is passed as the tokenId to mushroomNft.mint.
nextId local is derived from mushroomNft.totalSupply().add(1).
mint delegates minting logic to _mintWithMetadata.
speciesId argument flows into mint and onward to _mintWithMetadata.
lifespan argument flows into mint and onward to _mintWithMetadata.
speciesId indexes mushroomTypeExists and mushroomTypes for validation.
lifespan is written into the MushroomData struct stored for the token.
recipient is passed to _safeMint inside _mintWithMetadata.
_mintWithMetadata performs species.minted.add(1) counter increment.
The incremented minted counter is written back into the mushroomTypes mapping.
burn calls _clearMushroomData after burning the token.
_clearMushroomData performs species.minted.sub(1) counter decrement.
The decremented minted counter is written back into the mushroomTypes mapping.
index argument selects the mushroomData entry to modify.
lifespan argument is written into the selected mushroomData entry.
setMushroomLifespan mutates the mushroomData mapping state.
initialize transfers contract ownership to the sporePool address.
newOwner parameter is assigned to _owner inside transferOwnership.
transferOwnership reassigns the _owner state variable.
mushroomNft state variable is set from the initialize argument.
sporeToken state variable is set from the initialize argument.
costPerMushroom state variable is set from the initialize argument.
mySpecies state variable is set from the initialize argument.
setMushroomType sets mushroomTypeExists for the species.
setMushroomType writes the MushroomType struct into mushroomTypes.
setSpeciesUri writes the URI into mushroomMetadataUri.
mySpecies is used to query getRemainingMintableForSpecies.
mint leads to _safeMint which performs a low-level onERC721Received callback to the recipient contract.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient parameter is an input to the _mintWithMetadata minting function.
numMushrooms parameter bounds the growMushrooms loop.
speciesId parameter selects the species validated in _mintWithMetadata.
lifespan parameter is stored into mushroomData by _mintWithMetadata.
index parameter identifies the mushroomData entry updated by setMushroomLifespan.
minLifespan parameter is an operand of the maxLifespan.sub(minLifespan) unsafe operation.
maxLifespan parameter is the receiver of the range subtraction unsafe operation.
nextId local is the tokenId passed to the external mushroomNft.mint unsafe call.
range local is the modulus of the timestamp-based randomness unsafe operation.
fromMin local is the modulo output that seeds the timestamp randomness result.
newOwner parameter is the argument assigned in transferOwnership.
local species struct is fetched inside growMushrooms to drive minting parameters.
